This is hymn number 234 titled "Jesus, Mighty King in Zion" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Tracy Y. Cannon and the lyrics were written by S. L. Catlett.
